actions.action: Move the plant a few feet from the window, out of drafts
Check soil moisture 2 inches down before watering
If dry, water until it drains and empty the saucer after 15 minutes
Set up a pebble tray with water under the pot
Refill pebble tray every few days
Trim fully brown or crispy leaves after new growth appears
If soil stays wet over a week or stems go soft or dark, check roots for rot

reason: The answer blames cold drafts rather than low humidity; it includes a weak humidity step (pebble tray) instead of the sealed-bag enclosure that worked, so the advice is only partial, but nothing recommended is likely to harm the plant.
